handbookNote: Iowa Driver's License Manual, Iowa Department of Transportation (fetched directly from the official complete-book PDF at iowadot.gov/media/7308/download, current edition referencing 'M M1170 07/23/2026' -- full text extracted with pdftotext and saved to temp/handbooks/ia/driver.txt, 2892 lines covering all 5 chapters: Your Driver's License, Traffic Signs & Rules of the Road, Preparing to Drive, Basic Driving Skills, and Applying Your Driving Skills). Graduated Driver's License (GDL) program specifics -- which the PDF manual itself only summarizes and defers to iowadot.gov for -- were separately fetched directly from the official Iowa DOT GDL sub-pages (instruction-permit-under-age-18, special-minors-restricted-license, intermediate-license, full-license) and appended to the handbook file as Appendix A, since the manual explicitly tells readers to visit those pages for full GDL detail. Real exam mechanics were researched from multiple official sources (documented in full as Appendix B of the handbook file): the PASSING SCORE of 80'%' or higher is CONFIRMED, stated consistently on iowadot.gov's Driver's Manual and Practice Test pages. The REAL TEST'S QUESTION COUNT is NOT CONFIRMED -- Iowa Administrative Code 761-604.9(1) (the binding regulation, current through ARC 9578C, eff. 11/5/25) explicitly states the department 'reserves the right to revise a test at any time and will declare the minimum passing score for each test,' and no official source states a fixed length for the real administered test. The only concrete number found (25 questions) is explicitly described by iowadot.gov as belonging to the ONLINE PRACTICE test only, drawn from 'a larger group of sample questions that includes questions from the real knowledge test' -- the site never equates practice-test length with real-test length, so no question count for the real exam is asserted anywhere in this build. Whether the real test is timed was also not stated in any official source found, so it is left unconfirmed rather than guessed. Test-validity (180 days) and retesting-at-examiner's-discretion were confirmed directly from IAC 761-604.9(3) and (4). This is a genuinely rich, detailed manual (traffic signs/signals/pavement markings, right-of-way and modern intersection types including roundabouts/reduced-conflict intersections/diverging diamonds, railroad crossings, school buses, Iowa's Move Over/Slow Down law and Steer It-Clear It law, detailed speed and stopping-distance tables, OWI/implied-consent/open-container law, seat belt and child-restraint law, Iowa's hands-free distracted-driving law, a full ADAS/vehicle-technology permitted-for-testing table, basic driving skills, sharing the road with trucks/motorcycles/bicycles/pedestrians, parking, work zones, and a full severe-weather/emergency/crash-reporting section) that comfortably supported a large, non-repetitive, 246-question bank across 12 topic buckets after an honest, thorough pass through the entire document -- no padding, invented facts, or restated questions. Price matches this project's established Driver track price ($4.99) site-wide, not a placeholder. Every question is grounded in a specific, cited passage of the fetched official manual text, its GDL appendix, or the IAC/exam-mechanics research appendix; none are invented or generic 'common knowledge' items.
